comment: Machine-readable twin of narration-phase1g.md. `tts` is the ElevenLabs synthesis input (FliHub spelled 'Fly Hub', 1H spoken 'one-H'); `caption` keeps the correct spelling. Also used by walkthrough-1g.mjs to pace scene holds (local word-count estimate, no API).

scenes.caption: Casey, the assigned scorekeeper, opens the FLI demonstration event on a phone. The scorecard already knows the setup: Round 1 · 9 holes · Red, an intermission, then Round 2 · 9 holes · Blue — with Group 1's two teams and their four athletes.
scenes.tts: Casey, the assigned scorekeeper, opens the F L I demonstration event on a phone. The scorecard already knows the setup: Round one, nine holes at Red, an intermission, then Round two, nine holes at Blue — with Group one's two teams and their four athletes.

scenes.caption: On hole 1 of Round 1, Casey enters strokes — every entry saves as a draft. One score is still blank, and the card says exactly why that matters: missing scores block submission and never count as zero. Casey fills it in, and Round 1 is submitted.
scenes.tts: On hole one of Round one, Casey enters strokes — every entry saves as a draft. One score is still blank, and the card says exactly why that matters: missing scores block submission and never count as zero. Casey fills it in, and Round one is submitted.

scenes.caption: After the intermission, Round 2 replays the same nine physical holes at the Blue positions. The card displays holes 10 through 18 — displayed hole 10 is physical hole 1 on the second pass — and each round's scores stay separate.
scenes.tts: After the intermission, Round two replays the same nine physical holes at the Blue positions. The card displays holes ten through eighteen — displayed hole ten is physical hole one on the second pass — and each round's scores stay separate.

scenes.caption: Later in the round, the card is nearly complete. Casey enters the final scores on hole 18 and submits Round 2. Submitted scorecards are locked against silent changes — official approval and published results arrive in Phase 1H.
scenes.tts: Later in the round, the card is nearly complete. Casey enters the final scores on hole eighteen and submits Round two. Submitted scorecards are locked against silent changes — official approval and published results arrive in Phase one-H.
